components.name: GEL server
components.role: Authoritative live tutorial service and source of canonical tutorial identities and source pages.
scope: Own live GEL tutorial records and canonical tutorial IDs.
Expose tutorial-list, summary, print and edit-form source representations.
authority: Authoritative for live tutorial existence and canonical tutorial_id.
Source representations may contain known anomalies governed by known_source_anomalies.json.
state_transitions: External GEL operations may append live tutorial records.
A live source change invalidates corresponding locally derived source snapshots until reacquired.
failure_semantics: Unavailable or malformed GEL source causes acquisition failure; local code must not invent source values.
tests: Live behaviour is represented by captured private fixtures and explicit evidence contracts; automated release gates perform no GEL tutorial write.

components.name: Canonical contracts
components.role: Highest-authority repository representation of known GEL field, applicability, anomaly, governance, ownership and release invariants.
scope: Store reviewed JSON contracts under contracts/.
Define inputs to generated Rust compatibility code and generated documentation.
Define semantic draft-origin, editable-source, provenance-only, collision-authority and offline POST round-trip invariants.
Own the executable archive v2 schema contract under schema/.
authority: Highest repository documentation authority below executable tests/schema.
Executable archive schema SQL is repository authority for D1 storage shape.
state_transitions: Reviewed contract edit changes canonical repository authority.
Any contract edit invalidates dependent generated artifacts until regenerated.
failure_semantics: Invalid or inconsistent contracts fail check:contracts/check:governance and release gates.

components.name: Contract tooling
components.role: Generate and validate projections of canonical GEL contracts.
scope: Generate gel-core/src/gel_fields.rs.
Generate contract documentation and hashes.
Validate Python/Rust contract projections.
authority: Derived only; never authoritative over contracts/*.json.
state_transitions: Canonical contract change marks generated projections stale; generator restores current state.
failure_semantics: Stale or inconsistent generated projections are hard failures.

components.name: Governance tooling
components.role: Generate and validate component specs, architecture/ownership documents, documentation index, release-gate projections, and meta-governance protocol/profile conformance.
scope: Generate active component specs from component boundary contract.
Generate architecture, state ownership, release gate and documentation index.
Validate one-writer and documentation-authority invariants.
Validate AI Governance Protocol v1.1 structural/semantic invariants and the GEL project profile binding.
Fail if the generic protocol/profile claims GEL runtime authority, overrides domain contracts, weakens portable/strict semantics, or references unknown gates/components/state classes.
authority: Derived only; canonical governance contracts remain authoritative.
The generic protocol and GEL profile are meta-governance decisions only; existing canonical GEL contracts/tests remain runtime/domain authority.
state_transitions: Governance contract or plan change invalidates generated governance docs; generator restores current state.
failure_semantics: Missing active spec, stale generated doc, invalid writer ownership or undocumented state class fails check:governance.

components.name: Python v4.9 archiver oracle
components.role: Historical Python v4.9 behavioural/parity oracle retained for A1/A2 regression evidence; no runtime canonical archive write ownership after A2.
scope: Define retained Python v4.9 summary-primary + print-fallback reference semantics.
Generate/verify parity fixtures and support historical regression investigation.
Remain executable as an explicit oracle utility only; it is not the production archive runtime after A2.
authority: Historical/reference oracle only after A2.
No production normalized_local_archive write authority.
Summary/print/edit semantics remain comparison authority where A1/A2 parity explicitly references v4.9.
state_transitions: None in production; oracle execution may produce disposable comparison output only.
failure_semantics: Oracle unavailability blocks parity evidence that explicitly requires it but never transfers runtime write ownership back to Python.
dependencies: historical optional requests/BeautifulSoup runtime for live oracle execution

components.name: Private fixture capture tooling
components.role: Capture private source evidence and normalized expectations for regression testing without becoming runtime authority.
scope: Capture 14 edit-form fixtures and two reconciliation cases.
Write Git-ignored private fixture tree and manifest.
authority: Evidence source only; capture does not automatically promote evidence_baseline.json.
state_transitions: Recapture invalidates previous private fixture contents.
Evidence baseline changes only through separate reviewed contract update after executed comparison.
failure_semantics: Partial capture is not accepted as strict release evidence.
tests: strict private-fixture release check when fixtures exist

components.name: Rust summary parser
components.role: Pure parser from GEL summary HTML to derived summary entries.
scope: Parse FixedTables summary structure and normalized labels.
Preserve duplicate same-timestamp entries.
authority: Derived parser output only; summary HTML and canonical contracts remain source authority.
state_transitions: Each parse creates fresh derived state; source HTML change invalidates previous parse output.
failure_semantics: Malformed required structure returns parser error or missing evidence; never invent fields.

components.name: Rust edit-form parser
components.role: Pure parser from historical GEL edit HTML to raw/effective edit-form state.
scope: Parse historical GEL edit HTML into a raw structural representation without inventing missing controls.
Recover browser-effective select values, including inline-JS selection and browser default-first-option semantics.
Recover Aims contenteditable separately from its hidden backing input and recover historical teacher selection evidence.
authority: Derived parser output; not authoritative for historical absent because of ANOM-ABSENT-001.
state_transitions: Each parse creates fresh derived edit state; source HTML change invalidates prior output.
failure_semantics: HTML/syntax parsing errors fail parsing.
Missing or structurally unexpected tutorial controls remain observable in raw parsed state; the validator, not the parser, decides contract validity.

components.name: Rust edit-form validator
components.role: Contract-driven fail-closed boundary between raw parsed GEL edit forms and semantic tutorial state.
scope: Classify each applicable historical GEL control as present value, present unset, missing or malformed.
Validate expected control kind, duplicate shape, selected-option and canonical select-option domains, complete radio option sets, positive numeric metadata and GEL date format.
Treat browser first-option select behaviour and contract placeholders as intentional present-unset state.
Reject known type-inapplicable tutorial controls rather than silently accepting contract drift.
authority: Derived validation only; canonical expected fields/kinds/applicability/unset policy come from repository contracts.
state_transitions: Raw parsed edit form → validated edit form only when every applicable required control is structurally valid and every forbidden known control is absent.
Any source HTML or field-contract change invalidates previous validation output.
failure_semantics: Missing, malformed or disallowed-unset required controls produce a validation error report; no validated state is returned.
Intentional placeholder/blank state is preserved as PresentUnset and is not conflated with Missing.
tests: private fixture parity gate (validator runs before comparison)

components.name: Rust New-tutorial form parser
components.role: Validate one acquired GEL New-tutorial form into immutable source authority without weakening the historical Revision edit-form validator.
scope: Parse the transient New-form HTML using the shared lexical form-control parser while keeping New semantic validation separate from Revision validation.
Require canonical POST form action/method, matching route uid/ttype, valid customdate, hidden positive tid and complete tutorial-type-applicable governed controls.
Require datetime to be absent on New; its presence is contract drift and never relaxes historical Revision datetime requirements.
Construct the sole production ValidatedNewFormTeacher authority from the hidden tid and expose no public integer constructor or mutation path.
Use canonical field identity/applicability only; never infer semantic provenance from equal values in unrelated controls.
Produce a deterministic normalized source fingerprint without retaining raw HTML or teacher display labels.
authority: Sole production writer of validated_new_tutorial_form_state and opaque New-form teacher authority.
Validation/source interpretation authority only; GEL remains live source authority and N2b grants no tutorial submission/network-write authority.
New and Revision form contracts remain structurally distinct; this component cannot construct validated historical edit state.
state_transitions: Acquired New-form HTML -> ValidatedNewTutorialForm only after all canonical source controls and route/type relationships pass.
A validation failure produces no partial validated source state.
Authentication/session invalidation or a refetched source-form change invalidates prior New-form source authority; it must not be silently rebound.
failure_semantics: datetime present, hidden tid missing/wrong-kind/non-positive, route uid/type mismatch or known inapplicable governed controls fail closed.
Missing required controls, wrong control kinds, invalid date or unknown canonical option values fail closed.
Login/session failure is handled at acquisition and yields no parser authority; parser errors never include raw HTML in Display diagnostics.
No failed parse returns a partially trusted teacher, date or form authority.

components.name: Rust print parser
components.role: Pure safe parser for GEL print HTML implementing the A1 Python-v4.9 print-fallback semantic shape for Rust archiver acquisition and parity evidence.
scope: Parse structured print rows without interpreting teacher prose as labels.
Return Python-v4.9-compatible teacher/student/date headers, print_text, fields, direct-label projection and Tutorial Type -> Type alias.
Remain a derived parser only: A1 strict acceptance additionally requires the private historical print fixture set.
authority: A1 parser authority for derived parsed_print_state and public Python-v4.9 print-parity fixtures.
No authority to mutate the canonical archive or live GEL tutorials; private-fixture parity is required before strict A1 acceptance.
state_transitions: Each parse creates fresh derived print state.
failure_semantics: Unknown/missing print rows remain absent rather than inferred from prose.
Parse/validation failure blocks print-derived evidence for the affected tutorial and is surfaced to A2 acquisition; it never invents source values.

components.name: Rust reconciliation
components.role: Pure association logic between canonical API identities and summary states, preserving collision evidence.
scope: Pair non-collision exact timestamp/date candidates without reusing consumed entries.
Keep same-timestamp collision summary candidates group-owned rather than positionally assigning them to canonical tutorial IDs.
Classify collision groups as identical_state, divergent_state or incomplete_evidence using governed summary state.
Resolve revision state only when per-ID authority is proven or all collision candidate states are identical.
authority: Derived association only; tutorial_id remains canonical identity and a collision candidate state cannot be upgraded to per-ID ownership without evidence.
Shared-identical state is revision-safe because candidate states are equivalent, but the source-entry association remains ambiguous.
state_transitions: Input identity/source-state changes invalidate reconciliation result.
Non-collision source state may become proven per-tutorial association.
Identical collision becomes shared-identical authority without deduplicating IDs.
Divergent or incomplete collision remains blocked for revision-by-ID.
failure_semantics: Divergent ambiguous collision returns no per-ID summary assignment and revision-state resolution fails closed.
Incomplete collision evidence returns no per-ID summary assignment and revision-state resolution fails closed.
Timestamp-only route state is never used as an implicit discriminator for canonical tutorial IDs.

components.name: Rust semantic form model
components.role: Construct and validate editable semantic tutorial state from governed source authority, including UI1c5-integrated field applicability, structured edit validation, Initial course-type storage adaptation, and New-only same-role CEFR regression protection.
scope: Normalize CEFR, assessments, exam state, Aims and comments.
Represent DraftOrigin explicitly as Revision { source, source_teacher_id } or New { optional prepopulation_source, opaque ValidatedNewFormTeacher }; New has no authoritative created GEL identity.
Bind teacher attribution immutably to origin authority: historical teacher for Revision, validated fetched New-form teacher for New; expose no semantic teacher reassignment path.
Keep one editable representation for each semantic value; raw overall-level text and Aims HTML are provenance-only.
Use archive/summary authoritative absent while retaining edit discrepancy provenance.
Represent Final Reading and enforce tutorial-type applicability invariants.
Require explicit historical state authority before constructing a revision-by-ID draft.
Treat an optional New prepopulation source as provenance only: when present it must be canonical and belong to the same student; first-ever New may have no source.
Keep source authority distinct from editable derived state; source/session changes invalidate rather than silently reinterpret a draft.

Construct New semantic state through the N2c field-by-field prepopulation contract: latest tutorial is carried source when present; validated New form supplies date/teacher/type and defaults for fields unavailable on the source type.

Project New level fields only from the same canonical semantic role: Initial-role fields copy only from Initial/Final sources; current-role fields copy only from Standard/Final sources; unavailable roles retain validated New-form defaults; equal values never create provenance.

Copy/reset type-specific state according to N2c: Standard-only self-assessment/Aims, Initial-only exam fields, Final-only additional comments; unavailable source-type fields fall back to validated New-form defaults.
Own the executable UI1c tutorial semantic field-disposition matrix: editable, read-only, hidden-preserved or inapplicable by tutorial type.
Project canonical CEFR, assessment and InitialCourseType option domains for safe Writer view models; React must not own those domains.

Interpret Initial teacher_comments through the lossless InitialCourseType adapter: exact HSP/G21/G15 are recognized, blank is unset, every other nonblank value is preserved verbatim until explicit replacement.
Reject direct Initial teacher-comment and hidden exam edits; hidden Initial storage survives unrelated edits unchanged.
Return structured DraftValidationIssue values for typed edit failures with stable code/field/severity/message/prior/candidate fields.
For New only, retain a same-role CEFR regression baseline derived from the N2c latest authoritative source snapshot and reject lower populated candidate levels with LEVEL_REGRESSION.
UI1c5 integrated cross-form acceptance is executable through dedicated structural and behavioral checks without changing runtime authority.
authority: Derived editable state only; archive/source evidence remains authoritative history.
N2a origin authority is executable: Revision identity/teacher are immutable source authority; New has no created identity and its form teacher is immutable source authority.
N2c is current authority for New draft prepopulation/default/reset semantics; GEL New-form values remain source/default evidence, not permission for cross-field inference.
UI1c0 is current authority for Writer field applicability, option domains, InitialCourseType storage adaptation, structured draft validation and New-only same-role CEFR regression.
state_transitions: Validated revision evidence creates a clean Revision semantic state bound to source identity and historical teacher.

Validated New-form authority may create a New semantic state with the latest prepopulation source when one exists, or no prepopulation source for a first-ever tutorial; N2b owns the sole production New-form authority constructor.
Semantic edits change only editable semantic fields and invalidate any derived POST payload.
A changed latest prepopulation source, authentication loss, or changed Revision source marks the relevant draft stale; it is never silently rebound.
Latest source + ValidatedNewTutorialForm -> New TutorialFormState only through N2c canonical field projection; first-ever New uses validated form defaults and has no source identity.
Typed UI1c edit -> field-disposition authorization -> candidate mutation -> semantic invariant validation -> same-role New regression validation -> replace state only on success.
failure_semantics: Semantic revision construction only accepts a validated GEL edit form and historical state authority that permits revision-by-ID.
Revision origin source identity must match student and tutorial type, and semantic teacher must equal source_teacher_id.
New form teacher authority must be positive and semantic teacher must equal the opaque validated New-form teacher; an optional prepopulation source must be canonical and belong to the same student.
New origin must never claim an authoritative created GEL identity before future fresh server readback.
Type-inapplicable populated fields fail semantic validation rather than being silently discarded.
Historical absent remains archive/summary-authoritative under ANOM-ABSENT-001.
Ambiguous divergent, incomplete, unmatched or legacy ambiguous-unknown archive state blocks revision-by-ID before semantic state construction.

N2c rejects a mismatched/non-canonical latest source and never copies across semantic dimensions or Initial/current roles; fields unavailable on the source tutorial type use validated New-form defaults rather than invented values.
Read-only, hidden-preserved and inapplicable UI1c fields reject direct edits with FIELD_NOT_APPLICABLE.
Invalid dates/options/text lengths and New same-role level regressions return structured DraftValidationIssue and leave the input state unchanged.

components.name: Rust offline POST mapper
components.role: Purely serialize governed semantic tutorial state through origin-specific New/Revision submission types to GEL form field/value pairs without network access.
scope: Validate semantic origin/type invariants before mapping.
Use distinct NewTutorialSubmission and RevisionTutorialSubmission views so New has no datetime serialization path and Revision derives datetime only from its source TutorialIdentity.
Serialize immutable teacher authority already bound by semantic validation; never offer a teacher reassignment writer.
Apply successful-control checkbox semantics.
Serialize type-applicable fields including Final Reading.

HTML-escape editable Aims plain text before converting newlines to
.
Enforce observed comment length limits.
Remain a pure mapper whose output can be independently checked against C4 source-derived expected payloads.
authority: Derived payload only; it has no permission to perform HTTP writes.
N2a submission authority: New omits datetime entirely; Revision emits the exact source tutorial_ts; teacher attribution is immutable origin authority.
state_transitions: Each mapping produces an ephemeral payload from one validated semantic snapshot.
New semantic state may transition only to a New-derived payload with no datetime key; Revision semantic state may transition only to a Revision-derived payload carrying exact source datetime.
Any semantic edit or source-authority invalidation makes an existing payload stale.
failure_semantics: Invalid semantic origin/type state fails before payload construction.
New/Revision submission constructors reject the wrong DraftOrigin.
New datetime serialization is structurally unavailable; Revision datetime is never caller supplied or defaulted.
Teacher mismatch against New-form or historical Revision authority fails before payload construction.
Invalid comment lengths fail mapping.
Source provenance is never a fallback input to submitted semantic values.
Any C4 exact payload or mutation-isolation failure blocks phase acceptance and later networking.
tests: private C4 round-trip checker via rust_fixture_tooling

components.name: Rust fixture/comparator tooling
components.role: Compare private source/archive evidence with derived parser, semantic, reconciliation and offline POST states through C4.
scope: Run semantic field parity across private fixtures.
Require every private edit form to pass C1 validation.
Require every private fixture pair to construct a valid C2 Revision state with matching explicit source identity.
Run the two private reconciliation fixtures through Rust summary parsing and C3 reconciliation.
Prove collision candidates remain group-owned, identical-state resolution is shared-state only, and divergent-state revision-by-ID is blocked.
Run all 14 private edit fixtures through archive + validated edit -> Revision semantic state -> POST payload.
Build an independent expected successful-control payload from validated source evidence plus governed archive absent authority and require exact map equality.
Count Final Reading coverage and historical absent discrepancies as governed C4 evidence.
Inspect summary/edit/print/revision fixtures.
Adapt captured expected-fixture JSON into semantic archive records for offline revision diagnostics.
authority: Diagnostic evidence only; it does not mutate canonical contracts automatically.
state_transitions: Fixture/source change invalidates prior comparison report.
failure_semantics: Strict gate requires exact approved parity baseline and allowlisted mismatch identities; unexpected mismatch/unavailable is failure.
Any private fixture that cannot pass C1 validation or C2 Revision construction is a strict failure.
Missing or unexpected C3 collision fixtures, positional collision assignment, or successful divergent revision resolution is a strict failure.

Any C4 fixture payload key/value difference, source timestamp identity mismatch, missing Final Reading field, wrong archive-authoritative absent encoding, or unexpected discrepancy count is a strict failure.

components.name: Archive schema v2 migration tooling
components.role: Create fresh archive-schema-v2 databases and migrate an explicitly supplied legacy archive into a separate candidate destination without changing canonical writer ownership.
scope: Apply schema/archive_v2.sql to empty candidate databases.
Migrate legacy classes/students/tutorials into normalized v2 identities, source states, memberships, collision groups and governed associations.
Extract minimal field-presence provenance from legacy raw_json and then discard the raw blob.
Fail closed on invalid parents, unrecognized schema shapes, missing collision identities or foreign-key violations.
Write migration output only to a separate destination database; never migrate the canonical legacy source in place.
authority: Executable schema/migration implementation for D1 candidate databases.
No authority to modify the configured canonical local archive or transfer canonical write ownership.
state_transitions: Empty destination -> fresh schema v2 candidate.
Legacy v1 source + absent destination -> separate migrated v2 candidate.
Any migration failure -> incomplete destination is deleted; source remains unchanged.
failure_semantics: Migration never guesses missing canonical parents or collision IDs.
Legacy collision ambiguity remains blocked: candidate states are group-owned and per-ID source_state_id stays NULL.
Foreign-key violations are hard failures.
The D1 schema acceptance checker is offline and must not acquire requests/bs4 or other live-oracle runtime dependencies merely to validate SQLite storage behaviour.
tests: tools/check_archive_schema.py (stdlib-only; exact transitional UPSERT SQL extracted from oracle source, never runtime-imported)

components.name: Rust archive v2 read repository
components.role: Public read-only typed repository over an existing archive-schema-v2 database for Writer/Viewer navigation and fail-closed historical revision loading.
scope: Open only existing schema-v2 SQLite databases in read-only/query-only mode.
Expose typed class, membership, student and tutorial list models.
Construct ArchivedTutorial only from source-present governed revision state.
Reject missing/blocked collision authority, stale identity/state presence, wrong schema version and FK-invalid databases.
authority: Read projection authority for archive schema v2.
No authority to create, migrate, synchronize, invalidate or mutate archive history.
state_transitions: SQLite rows -> typed read models only.
Eligible governed identity/state -> ArchivedTutorial; blocked/stale authority -> explicit blocked result.
failure_semantics: Open fails unless PRAGMA user_version=2, migration metadata is present, required view exists and foreign_key_check is clean.
Revision loading fails closed rather than synthesizing values from missing/ambiguous state.

components.name: Rust A2 canonical archiver + private schema-v2 repository
components.role: A2 production canonical local-archive implementation: RustArchiver acquires source data and delegates all SQLite mutation to the crate-private transactional ArchiveSyncRepository.
scope: Resolve/create the production schema-v2 archive through RustArchiver; fresh creation is staged and atomically published.
Acquire open classes, rosters, optional student-profile enrichment, tutorial identities, summary/print/edit source evidence before opening the materialization transaction.
Preserve Python-v4.9 summary-primary/explicit-blank/print-fallback semantics and recover historical teacher identity from validated edit forms.
Upsert classes, students, memberships, immutable tutorial identities, source states and field evidence.
Persist collision groups/group-owned identities/states and governed associations.
Compute D1-compatible semantic source-state fingerprints.
Run whole materialization in one transaction and invalidate unseen rows only after a full run is marked complete inside that transaction.
Audit repository semantic invariants and foreign keys before commit.

On partial auxiliary summary/print/edit acquisition, preserve prior semantic source evidence for still-observed API tutorial keys while retaining authoritative absence handling for disappeared identities.
authority: Sole production canonical writer of normalized_local_archive and archive_reconciliation_metadata after A2.
RustArchiver is the public production orchestration entry point; ArchiveSyncRepository remains crate-private and cannot be constructed by external Writer/Viewer consumers.
Python v4.9 is historical/reference only after A2.
No authority to mutate live GEL tutorials.
state_transitions: missing canonical DB -> staged fresh schema-v2 DB -> validated -> atomic rename.
authenticated source acquisition -> complete in-memory snapshot -> running sync row -> transactional materialization -> complete -> scope-aware invalidation/preservation -> invariant audit -> commit.
Any operation/finalization failure -> rollback materialization and mark outer sync row failed.
Unique print-only timestamp may become proven_per_tutorial; same-timestamp collision candidates remain group-owned/fail-closed.
failure_semantics: Existing non-v2/invalid archive is rejected; no destructive in-place migration or replacement.
Canonical tutorial_id re-key attempts fail hard.
Invalid collision association shape/group ownership fails before write or pre-commit audit.

Failed/rolled-back sync never invalidates prior source presence; completed FullPreserveSourceEvidence runs may invalidate truly disappeared identities while preserving semantic evidence for still-observed tutorial keys.
Commit/invariant/FK failure is a hard error; no blind best-effort canonical mutation.
Partial auxiliary evidence is surfaced in ArchiveSyncReport and cannot erase prior semantic evidence for API tutorial keys still observed in the completed run.

components.name: Rust GEL session
components.role: Own authenticated GEL HTTP session state and expose a fixed read-only acquisition surface without leaking credentials/cookies or granting tutorial mutation authority.
scope: Perform the established two-POST Learn2 login handshake and verify both api2 and learn2 authenticated sessions.
Expose fixed GET methods for open classes, class students, student profile, tutorial list, tutorial summary, tutorial print, current New-tutorial source form and historical tutorial edit pages.
Acquire a New form only through /study/tutorials/add/{student_uid}/0/{ttype_raw}; the fixed zero locator is read-source semantics and grants no create authority.
Project tutorial-list JSON to canonical tutorial id/timestamp observations without parsing semantic tutorial content.
Strip student email-like fields recursively before roster/profile JSON leaves the component.
Keep credentials transient and cookies private to the session client; expose no generic request function or cookie jar.
Permit no GEL tutorial create, revise or delete transport.
authority: Transport/acquisition authority only; GEL server remains authoritative for live source content and canonical tutorial IDs.
The only N1 HTTP POST authority is the two-step Learn2 login handshake; all exposed acquisition operations after authentication are GET.
N1 does not transfer canonical archive write ownership from the Python v4.9 oracle and does not grant submission authority.
state_transitions: Unauthenticated -> authenticated only after both api2 and learn2 verification succeed.
Authenticated -> unauthenticated on HTTP 401/403 or a detected Learn2 login redirect/form.
Each successful GET replaces the corresponding ephemeral runtime source snapshot; it never promotes the snapshot to canonical local archive state.
failure_semantics: Reads fail before transport when the session is unauthenticated.
Authentication/network/source-shape failures fail closed and never synthesize source values.
Malformed tutorial-list identity rows fail rather than inventing tutorial_id or timestamp.
Authentication errors must not include passwords, cookie values, serialized login bodies or full response bodies.
dependencies: reqwest blocking client with private cookie store
tests: gel_session unit tests for login/read method routing including fixed New-form GET, expiry detection, tutorial identity projection and privacy filtering
manual check_gel_read_only_live probe for live read-only parity
portable/strict release gate offline N1/N2b boundary checks

components.name: N2 Playwright zero-write evidence harness
components.role: Zero-write evidence harness for current GEL New/Edit browser behaviour; core N2 evidence is complete and changed-teacher submit serialization remains a deferred non-blocking diagnostic capability.
scope: Install a context-wide mutation firewall before the first browser navigation and block service workers so browser traffic cannot bypass routing.

Keep AUTHENTICATION active through the complete two-stage GEL login: manual /corelogin/ submission, GET-only Learn2 session verification, and—when required by the observed historical handshake—manual /user/login submission followed by the same GET-only verification. Credentials remain browser-only in both stages.

Classify network mutations by authority origin: unexpected GEL-origin mutations are aborted and fail closed; third-party mutating telemetry is aborted without body/header inspection and is non-fatal because it cannot write GEL tutorial state.

For blocked mutations, stderr-only terminal diagnostics may contain only phase, HTTP method, origin and a redacted path; query parameters, request body, headers, cookies and credential values are forbidden.
Emit only allowlisted static stage markers during live evidence so a fail-closed exception can be localized without printing student/teacher identity, URLs, form values or network payloads.

During EVIDENCE, permit no mutation to reach the network. For an explicitly armed /study/tutorials/process POST, reduce only tid/type/customdate/datetime structural relationships in memory and always abort the request.
Inspect current New forms for Standard/Initial/Final, the latest historical edit form, teacher-control topology and field-by-field New prepopulation behaviour.
Treat latest tutorial as the already-established New prepopulation source; PW1 records copy/reset/derive relationships rather than attempting provenance inference.

Where a genuine enabled teacher selector exists, an optional later residual probe may select an alternate only in the browser and observe authentic serialization; this is not required for N2 or normal Writer functionality and never authorizes server reassignment.
Verify zero writes by fresh GETs: New probes leave the tutorial locator digest unchanged and the revision probe leaves the historical semantic-state digest unchanged.

Persist only privacy-safe aliases, booleans, counts, non-identity semantic field names, relationship/classification labels, student-free digests and sanitized failure categories under a gitignored evidence directory. student_uid and teacher_id semantic keys are excluded from the persisted prepopulation field map.

Construct the persisted evidence preamble through a single privacy-validated helper; privacy policy metadata uses non-raw-data key names so the strict global guard can reject identity/body/header fields without false positives.
authority: Evidence-acquisition authority only; no production Tutorial Writer runtime authority.
May forward the canonical GEL login POST only before EVIDENCE. It has zero GEL tutorial mutation authority.
Third-party network traffic has no GEL state-writing authority. Blocking third-party telemetry is privacy protection, not GEL contract drift.
PW1 can record client-side teacher selection but changed-tid serialization/server acceptance is deferred non-blocking and cannot enable Writer reassignment.
Historical evidence remains authority for NEW-1/TEACHER-1/TEACHER-2/TEACHER-3/UPDATE-1; contradictory live evidence is contract drift requiring review.
state_transitions: BOOT -> AUTHENTICATION only after the mutation firewall is installed.

AUTHENTICATION stage 1: operator submits /corelogin/ manually; canonical /user/login POST may be forwarded without body/header inspection; GET-only /administration/students verification decides whether Learn2 is authenticated.
If stage 1 is not authenticated but a canonical login POST was observed: remain AUTHENTICATION -> GET /user/login -> operator submits that GEL form manually -> repeat GET-only session verification.
AUTHENTICATION -> EVIDENCE only after the GET-only Learn2 verification succeeds; never transition merely because the operator pressed Enter.
EVIDENCE optional residual teacher probe -> transient allowlist reduction -> ABORT; this path is not an N2 completion dependency.
EVIDENCE -> VERIFY -> CLOSED only after fresh GETs prove locator/state digests unchanged.

Any unexpected GEL-origin mutation, failed second-stage authentication, submission encoding drift or state change -> FAILED_CLOSED; third-party mutating telemetry -> ABORT_NONFATAL and remains in the current state.
failure_semantics: Unexpected GEL-origin mutation requests are aborted and fail the run without inspecting their bodies or headers.
Third-party mutating requests are aborted without body/header inspection, counted separately, and do not fail the run or become GEL contract-drift evidence.
Blocked-mutation diagnostics contain only phase, method, origin and a redacted path and are terminal-only; queries, bodies, headers, cookies and credential values are never printed or persisted.
A fail-closed runtime exception may be preceded by an allowlisted static stage marker only; the exception message itself remains suppressed.
Unexpected tutorial submission encoding is aborted and classified as contract drift; raw body persistence is forbidden.

No observed tutorial POST during an optional teacher-change probe is INCONCLUSIVE residual evidence only; it does not fail N2 functional acceptance and must never be bypassed with synthetic submission.
Runtime exceptions are reported by category only so live URLs/page/request data are not echoed to diagnostics.
A changed post-probe tutorial locator digest or historical semantic digest is a critical zero-write failure.

If the operator presses Enter while still unauthenticated, the harness remains in AUTHENTICATION, reports only privacy-safe session-verification facts, and either enters the historical second manual /user/login stage or fails closed; it never proceeds to tutorial evidence on an unverified session.
A local privacy-projection contradiction (for example, an identity-bearing semantic key reaching persisted evidence) fails before file write; the privacy guard is not weakened to admit it.

Persisted privacy-policy metadata must itself pass the same global privacy guard. False-positive schema/key collisions are repaired by renaming metadata, never by weakening the forbidden raw-data key guard.
tests: Complete prepopulation classification containing transient student_uid/teacher_id inputs reduces to S1/relationship-only identity rules and passes the persisted-evidence privacy guard.
The complete initial evidence document passes assert_privacy_safe_evidence and contains no forbidden raw-data key fragments.

components.name: Tutorial Writer Tauri application service
components.role: Own the Tutorial Writer runtime orchestration boundary: transient GEL read session use, read-only archive navigation, one explicit governed A2 archive-sync trigger, one ephemeral Rust-owned tutorial draft, typed semantic edits and safe frontend view models.
scope: Use D2 ArchiveRepository read-only models for class/student/tutorial navigation.
Open New drafts only by composing latest authoritative archive source, N2b validated New form and N2c build_new_form_state.
Open Revision drafts only from D2 revision authority plus fetched/validated historical edit form and C2 semantic construction.
Own one ephemeral base/current draft container and serialize state-changing operations.
Apply frontend edits only through rust_semantic_form::apply_tutorial_draft_edit candidate-before-commit semantics.

Expose only an explicit Tauri command allowlist; no tutorial submit/create/revise/delete, generic HTTP, teacher reassignment or raw POST command exists. The sole local archive mutation trigger is ui1_sync_archive, which delegates to public RustArchiver and never exposes ArchiveSyncRepository.
Project Writer student view models from D2 source fields: course start/end and attendance.
Derive last-tutorial date/type only from the first item of D2 canonical newest-first tutorial history; do not synthesize it in React.
Project recognized archive overall-level labels to compact canonical CEFR codes in safe UI view models while preserving authoritative source text unchanged.
Project UI1c field-disposition rules and Rust-owned CEFR/assessment/InitialCourseType option domains in DraftView.formContract.
Project InitialCourseType state without asking React to parse teacher_comments.
Return DraftValidationIssue directly from ui1_apply_draft_edit; infrastructure failures are mapped to structured non-field issues.
Project Aims assistance as unavailable while ui1c_aims_assistance is absent_not_curated.

Resolve archive path with non-empty GEL_ARCHIVE_DB first; otherwise use gel-new-v2.db beside the running executable on Windows and project-root gel-new-v2.db on non-Windows. Navigation opens ArchiveRepository read-only; authenticated ui1_sync_archive may ask RustArchiver to atomically create a missing schema-v2 DB or synchronize an existing valid one.
UI1c5 adds no Tauri command; integrated acceptance reuses the existing UI1c typed edit/draft surface.
Expose Rust-owned Harper check/suggestion DTOs and dictionary add/remove/list commands without granting tutorial write authority.
Intercept window CloseRequested events when the active draft is dirty, prompting for discard confirmation before window destruction.
Transition writer_active_draft to stale_source upon session expiry or remote latest-tutorial drift; forbid silent rebinding to new source or teacher authority.
Ensure all navigation actions (class selection, student change, New tutorial opening, Revision opening, logout) enforce discard guards when draft is dirty.
Coordinate production tutorial submission via live_submission_transport, triggering post-submit readback and targeted archive reconciliation.
authority: Application orchestration authority only; semantic field validity remains rust_semantic_form authority, archive history remains D2/Archiver authority, and GEL session transport remains rust_gel_session authority.
May replace writer_active_draft only with fully validated semantic state returned by higher-authority components.
May trigger canonical local archive synchronization only by delegated RustArchiver::sync_full; this does not grant direct SQLite/ArchiveSyncRepository capability or GEL tutorial mutation authority.
Serialize Harper dictionary mutations through the existing writer_operation lock; the dictionary repository remains the sole durable dictionary writer.
state_transitions: No draft -> New/Revision open -> clean writer_active_draft.
Clean -> typed semantic edit -> validated candidate -> dirty; failed candidate leaves prior draft unchanged.
Draft -> discard/logout -> no draft.
Later UI1 gates may add explicit stale/invalid transitions but never silent source rebinding.
Draft -> session expiry / remote latest-tutorial drift -> stale_source; direct editing locked; silent rebinding forbidden.
Dirty draft -> window close requested -> intercepted -> discard confirmed -> no draft + window destroyed.
Dirty draft -> window close requested -> stay -> remain dirty in-memory.
failure_semantics: Blocked/ambiguous D2 revision authority refuses Revision opening.
Missing authentication refuses New/Revision live source acquisition without affecting archive navigation.
Failed semantic edit returns an error and leaves current authoritative in-memory draft unchanged.
Structured edit failures are returned without mutating writer_active_draft; React may render message/field metadata but cannot infer semantic authority from strings.
A missing archive may be created only by authenticated explicit RustArchiver sync. Existing invalid/non-v2 archives fail closed and are never replaced or migrated in place by Writer.

Archive synchronization failure leaves RustArchiver/ArchiveSyncRepository transactional failure semantics authoritative; Writer receives an error and does not fall back to raw SQLite or Python mutation.
Session loss while writing transitions draft to stale_source; New drafts cannot rebind to an unauthenticated session.
Window close attempt while dirty cannot silently drop in-memory draft without explicit discard confirmation.

components.name: Tutorial Writer React presentation
components.role: Render the selected A+D hybrid browse/write layout from safe Rust view models, collect transient credentials/input and invoke only typed UI1 Tauri commands.
scope: Use CELS-derived AG Grid patterns for read-only student/tutorial navigation.
Keep class/student/filter/busy/error/dialog/password state as presentation-only React state.
Render only safe semantic DraftView values; never construct GEL form IDs, tid, datetime, TutorialIdentity or raw POST state.
Send semantic TutorialDraftEdit variants only; no frontend teacher/origin/identity mutation surface.
Clear password state in a finally block after every login attempt and use no localStorage/sessionStorage.
Browse mode uses a focused two-pane layout: Student/Course/Attendance/Last tutorial on the left and selected-student facts/actions/history on the right.
Write mode makes the editor dominant and keeps student context in a collapsible compact rail.
School and internal database identifiers are not visible in the normal interface.
React may format course ranges and tutorial labels but must not derive missing authoritative archive values.
Render the compact CEFR level strings supplied by Rust; do not parse, strip descriptors from, or otherwise reinterpret authoritative level text in React.
Consume DraftView.formContract rather than duplicating CEFR, assessment or InitialCourseType option domains.
Use Rust-projected field disposition for currently rendered editable controls; hidden-preserved fields are not directly editable.
Accept structured DraftValidationIssue objects and display their message without parsing strings for field identity.
Do not render an Aims preset/hotlist while the assistance contract is absent_not_curated.
Render reusable disposition-aware UI1c1 semantic controls for the existing foundation surface from Rust-projected form contracts.
Retain and present structured DraftValidationIssue DTOs without parsing their message text for semantic authority.
Render UI1c2 Standard, UI1c3 Initial and UI1c4 Final complete semantic form sections using only Rust-projected field dispositions, option domains and text limits.
UI1c5 introduces no new React semantic authority; integration acceptance covers existing complete form composition.
Render Rust Harper findings/suggestions for Aims, Teacher Comments and Final Additional Comments; apply suggestions only through typed semantic edits.
Render the explicit local Harper dictionary panel through Tauri DTOs; never persist dictionary state in browser storage.
Render inline Harper highlighting (mirror-div wavy underlines, spelling/grammar color variants) for Teacher Comments and Final Additional Comments; aims remains a side-panel-only assistant.
Render per-finding actions: apply suggestion (label + full replacement text), add to dictionary (single-token gate), disable rule (session-only), skip issue (session-only).
Hoist session-only disabled-rules and ignored-findings state to App so it survives per-field editor unmount/remount; never persist them.
Listen for window close requests via Tauri event lifecycle, triggering DiscardDraftDialog when draft is dirty before window close.
Display stale_source status pill and banner when draft authority is invalidated, disabling direct editing until explicit user resolution.
Ensure all navigation paths (class selection, student change, New tutorial opening, Revision opening, logout) prompt for discard confirmation if current draft is dirty.
authority: Presentation-only; backend Rust contracts are authoritative for archive, session and semantic draft state.
Presentation-only editor-kind/composition choices do not create GEL field, applicability, option-domain, validation, draft or persistence authority.
Type-specific React layout is presentation composition only; rust_semantic_form remains authoritative for field applicability, domains, regression semantics and candidate validation.
state_transitions: Browse no student -> browse selected student.
Browse selected student -> New/Revision write mode.
Write mode -> browse selected student through discard/back; dirty state requires discard/stay confirmation.
Login attempt -> transient password -> finally clear password.
Structured validation issues may be displayed beside the corresponding complete type-specific field; rejected edits do not change the Rust-owned active draft.
Active draft -> stale_source notified -> render stale banner and lock editing.
Window close requested while dirty -> open DiscardDraftDialog; confirm -> destroy window; cancel -> stay.
failure_semantics: Backend errors are rendered as non-authoritative UI errors; frontend does not repair or invent semantic/source values.
Unauthenticated state disables live New/Revision opening while archive navigation remains available.
A field rendered by the wrong presentation branch still cannot emit an edit unless the Rust-projected disposition is editable; hidden_preserved/inapplicable fields render nothing.
Stale source or invalid draft status disables further typed edits until draft is discarded or session is restored.
Closing the window while draft is dirty is blocked until explicit user confirmation.
tests: frontend typecheck/build in ui1-initial release scope

components.name: Dependency lock tooling
components.role: Own reproducible dependency-resolution decision state and its derived lock-identity projection.
scope: Define one Rust workspace release graph rooted at Cargo.toml.
Generate Cargo.lock and writer-ui/package-lock.json only through their real package managers after an explicit dependency/workspace change.
Generate and validate governance/dependency-lock-manifest.json.
Detect LOCK_GENERATOR_UNAVAILABLE automatically per missing lock; never accept a manual override, placeholder lock, network failure or command failure as that exception.
authority: Sole repository writer of dependency_lock_state; package manifests remain reviewed source inputs.
Lock generation is explicit and never occurs as an incidental release-gate side effect.
A portable tool-unavailable exception can produce SKIP evidence only; it cannot create dependency identity or authorize strict/release promotion.
state_transitions: Dependency manifest edit -> lock state stale -> explicit generate_dependency_lockfiles.py -> validated lock decision -> derived lock manifest current.

Missing lock + corresponding generator absent -> portable LOCK_GENERATOR_UNAVAILABLE evidence -> dependency identity remains incomplete -> generator appears -> exception invalid -> lock generation required.
failure_semantics: Missing generator executable never fabricates lock bytes; portable lock validation reports explicit SKIP only for the affected missing lock(s).
If a missing lock has an available generator executable, dependency-lock validation fails rather than using the exception.
Network unavailability or package-manager command failure is not the tool-unavailable exception and fails generation.
Strict validation always fails while any required lock is missing; STRICT_ACCEPTED and RELEASE_ARTIFACT_VERIFIED require complete dependency identity.

components.name: Current-state projection tooling
components.role: Generate one machine-readable current project status projection from higher-authority contracts, plan, lock identity and accepted evidence references.
scope: Generate governance/current-state.json and docs/generated/CURRENT_STATE.md.
Expose artifact type, active application contract/development, required gate, dependency-lock status, last strict acceptance and blockers.
Expose active agent-governance protocol/profile identity without granting either runtime authority.
authority: Projection only; it cannot alter or override runtime/application contracts, state ownership, development plan or acceptance evidence.
state_transitions: Higher-authority input change -> projection stale -> generator deterministically rewrites projection.
failure_semantics: Stale projection fails check:current-state/check:governance; incomplete lock/acceptance state is represented honestly as a blocker rather than hidden.

components.name: Release artifact and acceptance tooling
components.role: Run governed release checks, bind strict evidence to exact source/dependency/toolchain identity, package accepted source without rebuilding, and verify final archive bytes.
scope: Execute portable/strict scopes from release_gate.json with explicit evidence classes and SKIP semantics.
Record strict evidence outside source with source fingerprint, lock-set hash and toolchain identity.
Fail closed unless accepted strict evidence matches current source fingerprint before packaging.
Stage governed files, create exact file checksum/release manifests, archive without rebuild, and verify ZIP bytes/receipt.
authority: Sole writer of repository-governed release acceptance/distribution evidence state.
Strict evidence is evidence, not self-promoting runtime authority; packaging cannot change source, dependencies or build outputs after acceptance.
state_transitions: working source -> checks -> strict accepted evidence -> identity revalidation -> staged immutable package -> checksum/ZIP verification -> release artifact receipt.
failure_semantics: Any FAIL/SKIP in strict mode prevents strict acceptance.
Source/lock mismatch after acceptance aborts packaging.
Archive/checksum mismatch aborts RELEASE_ARTIFACT_VERIFIED and never triggers rebuild.

components.name: Portable continuous enforcement
components.role: Continuously execute reproducible portable structural/build/behavioral checks without claiming target-host strict acceptance.
scope: Run contracts/governance/generated/lock/unit/static/frontend/intake checks on repository changes.
Use npm ci and Cargo --locked commands only.
Report portable structural status; never automatically promote a candidate or fabricate private/live evidence.
Validate the GEL agent-governance profile through check:governance; CI may not promote it or runtime state.
authority: CI evidence may prove portable invariants only. STRICT_ACCEPTED and RELEASE_ARTIFACT_VERIFIED require separate governed target-host/artifact evidence.
state_transitions: Source change -> new portable CI run -> pass/fail/skips evidence; no automatic promotion transition exists.
failure_semantics: Unavailable public build dependency fails CI rather than being mislabeled pass; unavailable private/live evidence remains outside CI and cannot be synthesized.

components.name: Writer Harper service
components.role: Rust-owned British-English Harper checking service for bounded Writer text fields.
scope: Check only Aims, Teacher Comments and Final Additional Comments.
Use harper-core 2.8.0 curated lint group with Dialect::British.
Build Document and LintGroup from the same merged curated+user dictionary.
Apply session-only disabled_rules and suppressed_kinds filters without mutating the dictionary.
Short-circuit Spelling findings when the user dictionary matches or covers the reported span (handles mixed alphanumeric product names like CHI365/Chi365).
Return DTOs containing messages, original text, span coordinates (char offsets, end-exclusive), stable rule names, suggestion labels and complete replacement suggestions; never mutate tutorial state.
authority: Derived assistance only; rust_semantic_form remains authoritative for tutorial values and typed edits.
No GEL/network/archive write authority.
state_transitions: text snapshot -> HarperCheckDto -> discard on source change/request-id change
disabled_rules/suppressed_kinds filter applied per check call without mutating dictionary
failure_semantics: Check failure becomes non-authoritative UI error; no draft mutation.

components.name: Harper dictionary repository
components.role: Sole writer of the local versioned Harper user dictionary.
scope: Own schema-v1 JSON dictionary state and deterministic normalization.
Perform add/remove/list operations and atomic recovery-safe writes.
Migrate legacy array/object representations and reject future schemas.
authority: Sole writer of harper_user_dictionary.
Never establishes tutorial semantic authority.
state_transitions: load -> canonical state
add/remove -> candidate normalized state -> atomic replacement
failure -> prior canonical state remains authoritative
failure_semantics: Failed promotion restores prior canonical file.
Backup cleanup failure after successful promotion does not report mutation failure.
Future schema fails closed without downgrade.

components.name: Live submission transport
components.role: Submit governed tutorial POST payloads to the authoritative GEL server and discover canonical tutorial identity via post-submit readback.
scope: Construct and dispatch authenticated POST /study/tutorials/process requests using the session client.
Enforce New vs Revision submission rules: datetime omitted for New, exact source timestamp preserved for Revision; immutable origin teacher authority.
On submission success, immediately perform fresh GET /staff/students/{uid}/tutorials readback to discover canonical server-assigned tutorial_id and timestamp.
Trigger targeted RustArchiver sync to reconcile the server tutorial record into SQLite archive_v2.
On submission failure (network, 401/403, 500, HTML redirect), leave active in-memory draft dirty and retryable; forbid blind local SQLite insertion.
authority: Production GEL tutorial network write transport authority.
GEL server remains authoritative for live tutorial existence and canonical identity.
Client-side prediction of server-assigned tutorial identity or timestamp is strictly forbidden.
state_transitions: Ephemeral payload -> HTTP POST -> HTTP 200 / redirect -> GET readback -> targeted sync -> clear in-memory draft.
Ephemeral payload -> HTTP POST -> network failure / server error -> draft retained dirty and retryable.
failure_semantics: Transport or server failure preserves active draft dirty in process memory without silent discard.
No canonical SQLite row is synthesized on failure.
Network timeout triggers conflict check on retry before re-submission.
